as_written_in_papers.quote: A variant in the tumor necrosis factor, alpha-induced protein (TNFAIP)3 gene (c.997dupG) resulting in a frameshift (p.A333fs^*2) was found in P10 (Tables 2, 3).

cases.statement: One person: P10, a woman in a Danish cohort of 20 adults with CVID and autoimmunity, autoinflammation or malignancy, found by exome sequencing.

people.label: P10
people.zygosity_or_genotype: not stated in words for P10; listed in the paper's table of monoallelic variants
people.key_phenotypes: CVID diagnosed at 23 (Table 1); pneumonias and stomatitis; hepatosplenomegaly with splenectomy; pancytopenia with persistent CD4 lymphopenia; nodular regenerative hyperplasia of the liver with portal hypertension and oesophageal varices

quotes.quote: | P10 | F | CVID | 23 | Pneumonia, stomatitis | Elevated liver enzymes | Anemia, trombocytopenia, splenomegaly (Splenectomized) |  |
Patient 10 was diagnosed with CVID 10 years ago and experienced severe disease with significant hepatosplenomegaly, pancytopenia with persistent CD4 lymphopenia, and pneumonias.
Liver biopsy showed nodular regenerative hyperplasia and esophagoscopy revealed portal hypertension and esophagus varices documented by esophagoscopy.

phenotype_specificity.statement: The patient's main diagnosis is CVID; the authors say the presentation shares many features with HA20. Testing was an exome filtered to 564 immune genes. In supplementary Table S2 (variants the authors considered unlikely to be disease-causing), P10 also has an IL2RG c.-83G>A variant.

quotes.quote: The clinical presentation of the patient shares many features with A20 haploinsufficiency.
while the remaining 29 variants in 15 patients were considered unlikely disease-causing (Table S2).

segregation.statement: Not done: inheritance listed as unknown.

quotes.quote: | P10 | TNFAIP3 | Zinc finger protein and ubiqitin-editing enzyme | AD Autoinflammatory syndrome, Behcet-like | Unknown | (23, 24) |

de_novo.statement: Unknown; the authors could not verify whether the variant is de novo or inherited.

quotes.quote: The variant harbored by P10 has not been described previously, and we have not been able to verify whether the variant is de novo or inherited

functional.statement: No functional testing of any variant in this study.

quotes.quote: In the present study, we were not able to functionally validate identified variants in vitro or in vivo

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Frameshift: c.997dup predicted p.(Ala333GlyfsTer2), in the OTU domain per the authors, who compare it with a different reported truncating variant (p.A332X).

quotes.quote: The variant in P10 is located in the ovarian tumor (OUT) domain as described for p.A332X, resulting in a severely truncated and rapidly degraded protein (35).

computational_predictions.statement: No SIFT, PolyPhen-2 or CADD value is given for this variant (blank cells in Table 2); the table gives only the gene's MSC cut-off of 3.313.

population_data_in_papers.statement: gnomAD frequency cell shows '-' in Table 2; the methods excluded variants at ≥0.01% (heterozygous) in 1000 Genomes, ESP, ExAC or gnomAD European.

quotes.quote: finally excluded variants that are observed with an allele frequency ≥0.01% (heterozygous) or 1% (homozygous variants) of the genomes in the 1,000 genomes project, the NHLBI ESP exomes (European American), the ExAC European Frequency, or the gnomAD European Frequency

authors_classification.statement: Table 2 gives ACMG class 4 for this variant; the text says the four class-4 variants were classified as likely pathogenic.

quotes.quote: Of the 11 described variants, four were classified as likely pathogenic according to ACMG guidelines, whereas the remaining were classified as variants of unknown significance (Table 2).

concerns: The paper uses NM_006290.3; the batch HGVS is on NM_001270508.2. The protein agrees (protein_check: agrees); the paper writes p.A333fs*2 without the new residue.
Second variant in the same person: IL2RG c.-83G>A (NM_000206.2), listed by the authors among variants considered unlikely to be disease-causing (supplementary Table S2).
The main diagnosis is CVID in an adult cohort; the A20 link is the authors' suggestion from overlapping features, not a phenotype-driven diagnosis.
Zygosity is not stated in words; the variant is in the table headed 'Monoallelic variants identified'.
The authors cite a different variant (p.A332X) from another report when describing the expected effect; that statement is not about this variant.
notes_for_panel: Exome-sequenced CVID cohort; one carrier with no segregation, no parental testing and no functional work. The authors' table assigns ACMG class 4.
